caption: What if your voice kept getting louder and louder? A whisper is about 30 decibels and normal talk about 60, and every +10 dB sounds roughly twice as loud. At 85 dB, busy traffic, 8 hours can damage your hearing. An ambulance siren up close hits about 110 dB, where damage can start in just 2 minutes. India's legal limit for a single firecracker is 125 dB, measured 4 metres from the burst. A jet taking off is about 140 dB, and sound starts to hurt. In 1883 the Krakatoa eruption measured about 172 dB from 160 km away, was heard 4,800 km across the Indian Ocean, and its pressure wave circled Earth about 7 times. Plot twist: Earth's air can't carry a sound wave much louder than about 194 dB. Push harder and it becomes a shockwave. Noise damage is permanent, so enjoy Diwali from a safe distance. What's the loudest thing YOU have ever heard? 👇
